stories.title: Probe All You Want
stories.description: A street at night, in fog. Bots read the certificate log and try every door of a full-stack shop. Our site is a printed page: reach through its door and you grab nothing. The CDN just hands out "not here".
stories.articleTitle: Probe all you want, there's no compute here...

stories.title: How We Make These
stories.description: How the Report's films are made, in their own material. It opens on the manifesto's ten rules folding a running application down to almost nothing; then one page becomes a street, a mill and a city, and the storytelling moves are shown, not told.

stories.title: GitHub Didn't Break Today
stories.description: GitHub as a folded-paper machine. Copilot's belts are driven through the wall by engines GitHub doesn't own, and when one stops, its belt jams for 174 minutes. Nothing GitHub runs broke.
stories.articleTitle: GitHub Didn't Break Today. Its Model Vendor Did.
